alerts.title: Creatinine monitoring overdue while on TDF
alerts.message: Creatinine last recorded 478 days ago for a patient on TDF. Consider ordering repeat renal function monitoring.
alerts.query_hint: TDF renal function monitoring creatinine schedule

alerts.title: Creatinine not monitored for over 12 months
alerts.message: Patient on TDF + DTG, both associated with renal effects, but creatinine was last measured 478 days ago. No renal monitoring has been ordered at this visit. Regular creatinine monitoring is essential for patients on TDF-containing regimens to detect nephrotoxicity early. The clinician's plan of routine follow-up with no issues does not include renal function assessment.

evidence.recommended_action: Order serum creatinine and urinalysis to assess renal function given TDF use and >12-month gap since last creatinine.

alerts.title: Viral load 40 copies/mL — confirm threshold
alerts.message: Latest viral load is 40 copies/mL (113 days ago), which is below the 50 copies/mL threshold cited in guidelines. Per the DTG monitoring flowchart, VL < 50 copies/mL means the regimen should be continued. However, this VL was obtained approximately 3 months prior to the current visit. Guidelines suggest checking VL every 6 months for patients on DTG-based first-line ART, so the timing is acceptable.

evidence.recommended_action: Continue current regimen. Next viral load due approximately 6 months from last test (around April 2026).
